title: Cyberattack claims to reveal Russian soldier losses in Ukraine
content_md:
A cyberattack may have revealed how many soldiers Putin has lost in Ukraine, according to a figure presented by hackers.

via Mastodon https://stirileprotv.ro/stiri/international/un-atac-cibernetic-ar-fi-dezvaluit-cati-soldati-a-pierdut-putin-in-ucraina-cifra-prezentata-de-hackeri.html
exclude_reason: Unverified claim of hacker-disclosed Russian casualty figures, no technical substance or corroboration.
